Name: Apply SSL cert from Windows cert store to IIS

Properties.Name: Certificate lookup mode
Properties.Description: Select how the certificate is located.

Properties.Name: Certificate store name
Properties.Description: Machine certificate store containing the certificate, for example My or WebHosting.

Properties.Name: Certificate thumbprint
Properties.Description: Exact certificate thumbprint, usually bound to an earlier step output.

Properties.Name: Certificate common name
Properties.Description: Common name used to select the newest valid matching certificate.

Properties.Name: Website name
Properties.Description: Name of the existing IIS website.

Properties.Name: Binding host name
Properties.Description: DNS host name for the HTTPS binding, for example www.example.com.

Properties.Name: Require SNI
Properties.Description: Enable Server Name Indication. When disabled, IIS selects the certificate by IP and port.
